target_problem: compress locality-three range avoidance by safely replacing canonical output fibers with affine hulls and measuring the remaining global affine dimension
conditional_implication: For a consistent canonical affine-hull system of coefficient rank R, let nu=n-R. A block basis uses at most R selected output coordinates, leaves more than nu unselected coordinates, and its relaxed domain has exactly 2^nu assignments. Enumerating those assignments constructs a missing word in O(2^nu poly(N)); inconsistent hulls give an immediate missing canonical target word.
frontier_reason: V103 gives a new parameterized constructive regime, exactly exposes the 56 balanced-nonaffine essential ternary full-hull predicates as its local blind spot, and gives an infinite exact-stretch family with nu=1 while V97 lambda=4k, V101 mu=k+1, and V102 beta=3k.

bridge_lemmas.name: each exact target fiber is contained in its affine hull, so hull replacement is a safe relaxation
an inconsistent canonical affine-hull system makes the canonical target word absent
a greedy gate-block basis uses s<=R output coordinates and spans rank R
the selected relaxed domain has exactly 2^(n-R) assignments
m-s>n-R guarantees a missing residual output constructible from the enumerated relaxed domain
exactly 162 of 218 essential ternary masks have a proper canonical affine hull and the remaining 56 are balanced non-affine
the explicit 0x16 bridge family has rank n-1 and nu=1
the same family has exact V101 mu=k+1
the same family has exact V102 beta=3k
the same family has V97 lambda=4k and V100 zero peels
all high-nu balanced-nonaffine residual systems are polynomial-time avoidable

closed_route: requiring V101 acyclicity for every useful local relaxation; affine-hull equations allow cyclic constraints to be compressed globally by rank
surviving_route: combine functional graph relaxations, strong affine backdoors, and affine-hull rank on the 56 balanced-nonaffine full-hull predicates, or construct a family where all four parameters lambda, mu, beta, and nu remain linear
current_gap: Balanced non-affine ternary fibers have full affine hull, and nu(C) can remain linear. V103 does not provide a worst-case upper bound on nu or a general compression for the 56 full-hull essential predicates.
stop_rule: Do not promote V104 from another truth-table census. Require a symbolic hybrid constructor, an FPT parameter with strict infinite-family separation beyond nu, or a scalable obstruction for high-nu balanced-nonaffine systems.
external_validation_target: prior-art review of affine-hull relaxation for range avoidance; comparison with exact affine-fiber V56, ECCC TR22-102, TR23-072, TR23-193, TR25-034, and TR25-049
